title: Projection cache storage
responsibility: Provide disposable projection caching in R2 or an in-memory fallback.

inputs.name: hubCache.bucket
inputs.description: Optional R2 bucket holding projection entries under the 'projections/' key prefix. Omitting it (or passing a falsy value) selects an in-memory cache whose Map is created fresh for each hubCache call, so nothing is shared between calls; R2 is a disposable projection store, and authority always comes from GitHub before use.

outputs.name: hubCache
outputs.description: Object with get, put and delete methods, backed by R2 or by memory. With R2, entries go under 'projections/' with identity (JSON-encoded) and sha256 as custom metadata, get returns null for a missing object or read failure, and put/delete swallow bucket call errors; with memory, put stores a structuredClone of the entry and get returns that same retained object or null.

errors.name: DataCloneError
errors.description: Memory put rejects with a DataCloneError when structuredClone cannot copy the entry (for example one holding a function), and the entry is not stored.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: R2 put rejects with a TypeError when JSON.stringify(entry.identity) throws (for example on a circular or BigInt identity), because it runs before bucket.put is called, so the .catch in saveBucket never sees it.
